theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_bh_moving_blowUp_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ K → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → ∀ (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, c ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (blowUp T (xs j) (lams j) (hlams j).ne').massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c
